title: Seven-Segment Display
description: Interactive p5.js simulation demonstrating how seven-segment displays work, with individual segment control and digit pattern visualization.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Seven-Segment Display
Digital Display
Electronics
LED Display
learningObjectives: Identify each of the seven segments by its standard letter name A through G in the display layout
Construct every digit from 0 to 9 by toggling the correct combination of individual segments
Explain why the digit 8 requires all seven segments while the digit 1 lights only segments B and C
Translate between a decimal digit and its seven-bit segment on/off pattern using the standard mapping table
